item.title: I Hate (Most) Keyboard 'Fn' Keys
item.description:

It was nice that they gave dedicated keys to volume control/toggling muting – we use those all the time. I don’t want any of these “special function keys.

item.title: Smudging the game disc to make speedrunning 'SpongeBob' faster
item.description:
📝 The SpongeBob speedrunner recently shared a YouTube video on how to tear through the 18-year-old video game. It involves carefully smudging the game disc’s readable surface. While SHiFT insists that the method of smudging your disc will give you enough time in a lag to beat the SpongeBob game, he adds a clear caveat that it's not worth the risk of permanently damaging your game or original Xbox console.
🔗 Read more: https://www.inverse.com/input/gaming/the-dirty-secret-that-makes-speedrunning-on-spongebob-a-lot-faster
